# muxt generate-fake-server for a package of a route_paths module writes a
# fake server that builds with the hub.

muxt generate
muxt generate-fake-server admin
exists cmd/explore-goland/main.go
exists cmd/explore-goland/internal/fake/receiver.go
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- muxt.json --
{
  "route_paths": {},
  "package_defaults": {
    "use_receiver_type": "Server"
  },
  "packages": {
    "example.com/m/admin": [
      {}
    ],
    "example.com/m/blog": [
      {}
    ]
  }
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
